newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down after Wall St plunge.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down after Wall St plunge.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended with losses on Tuesday, hurt by Wall Street's plunge on Monday following remarks made by Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto about U.S. Treasuries.

"The Dow's fall brought the indices down, but the supply/demand situation is still pretty good and domestic institutional investors saw it as a chance to bargain-hunt," said Katsumichi Shimizu, Yamaichi Securities deputy general manager. "Such buying prevented losses from snowballing." The Nikkei 225 finished at 20,341.93, down 94.21 points or 0.46 percent. Its September futures fell 40 to 20,370.
